apparatus.crit: vīryād dākṣyād adhr̥ṣyatvād arthajñānān nayāj jayāt
vatsagargakarūṣāṃś ca puṇḍrāṃś cāpy ajayad raṇe
mācellakāṃs trigartāṃś ca yaudheyāṃś cārdayac charaiḥ
dhr̥ṣṭaketuś ca saṃrabdho matsyāś cānvapatan raṇe
devam ārādhayac charvaṃ gr̥ṇan brahma sanātanam
yadi putraṃ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam
ātmāpahāriṇāṃ yā ca yā ca mithyābhiśaṃsinām
punaś cānyais tribhir bāṇair mohayann iva
hayair nāgaiś ca saṃbhinnair nadadbhiś cārikarśanaiḥ
dhvajam ekena bāṇena vivyādha yudhi māriṣa
tair lalāṭārpitair bāṇair yuyudhānas tv ajihmagaiḥ
rathānīkāt tamaso bhāskaraṃ yathā didhārayiṣur ācāryaḥ
tayor yuddham abhūd yaś cāsīd vijayī
bhīmasenaṃ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā jvalantam iva pāvakam
hato vikarṇo rājendra citrasenaś ca vīryavān
jetāro vr̥ṣṇivīrāṇāṃ na punar mānuṣā raṇe
prabhañjanam ivādrirāṭ kiran bāṇagaṇān rājañ śataśo ’rjunamūrdhani
tad rakṣaḥ tac cāsīt prādur agrataḥ
tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ
trailokyarājyād yat kiṃ cid bhaved anyat sudurlabham
sarvāstravid bhavān hanyād divyair astrair na
hate virāṭe drupade kekayeṣu tathaiva ca
chatrair ābharaṇair vastrair mālyaiś ca susugandhibhiḥ
naivedaṃ mānuṣaṃ yuddhaṃ nāsuraṃ na ca rākṣasam
krodhād yaś cāviśal lokāṃs tasmāc charva
